definition: Use of force (air/missile/ground strike) with military intent.
Limited operation to seize assets/persons without broad campaign framing.
Force applied with detention/capture of leadership or personnel.
Denial of air transit rights / closure announcements with enforcement signals.
Refusal/withdrawal of basing refuelling or transit permissions.
Denial of port entry/servicing.
Explicit withholding/stop of arms aid ISR or training.
Explicit release/approval of arms aid ISR or training.
Listing/designation asset freezes or transaction bans.
Threat/application of sanctions against third parties for dealing with target.
Mandatory/expanded inbound screening rules at bloc/national level.
Compelled sale/unwinding of ownership rights.
Prohibition/notification/conditions on outbound investment in covered sectors.
Explicit import or export ban.
Quota or tariff-rate quota implemented/changed.
Tightened origin verification / anti-circumvention enforcement.
New tariff action on a sector not previously covered or major expansion.
Increase in tariff rate on existing tariff line(s).
Definitive duties adopted (multi-year typical).
Provisional anti-dumping/countervailing duties.
Temporary safeguard action.
Prohibition on import of specific energy commodities or products; may be phased or scheduled with staggered compliance deadlines.
Price cap mechanism with moving formula / adjustment rule.
Restriction on shipping insurance/services linked to compliance.
Physical interdiction/seizure of vessel/cargo.
Renewable annual licensing/approval replacing standing waivers.
Tiered global access framework caps/blocks by destination category.
Reported denial/hold of specific shipments/licenses.
Denial/throttling of cloud/API/model endpoint access.
Exclusion via standards/certification/interoperability requirements.
Termination of vendor support/updates/maintenance.
Judicial ruling compelling termination of a prior executive or regulatory action; controller loses instrument via external constraint not policy choice.
Rescinds/pauses a prior rule; a direction change not a loss of capacity.
Expulsion or recall of ambassadors as instrument of coercive signaling.
Formal recognition of a state/government or extension of existing recognition to new territory or claim.
Withdrawal of existing recognition or refusal to recognize a claim/government.
UN Security Council resolution under Chapter VII creating binding obligations.
Deliberate use of veto to shield a target from binding constraint; C3 is counterfactual (constraint blocked not imposed).
